cumleler: Which way do you pull a baby's ear for otoscopy?
In adults, the auricle, the outer ear, is pulled up and back.
In babies and young children, it is pulled down and back.
The bony canal is not yet developed; it is short and soft.
This approach is usually used until about three years of age.
